message.content:
Line 7 extracts the low byte into `htype`, so it can be `0x80` through `0xff` after the optional-extension check.

Line 12 indexes `mandatory_handlers[htype]`, but the array is declared with size `255` (valid indices `0` through `254`). If `htype == 255`, this is an out-of-bounds read.

Answer: 12
